english:
Grants <stasis Coldsnap Grenades /> better tracking. They travel 17.5% farther and faster.

Damaging an enemy with <stasis Coldsnap />, <arc Storm />, <strand Threadling />, or <void Vortex Grenades /> grants Grenade Ability Energy.

Energy based on the damaged enemy's <link Enemy Rank [#CombatantClassifications] /> (Coldsnap | other supported damaging Grenades):
• Enemy Players: 7% | 5%
• Tier 1 (T1) Minors: 10% | 3%
• T2 Minors, T1 Elites: 22% | 5.7%
• T3 Minors, T2 Elites: 34% | 8.4%
• T4 Minors, T3 Elites, and higher: 50% | 12%

Approximately 0.8 second cooldown between <void Vortex Grenade /> energy gains from the same target.

Healing yourself or allies with a <solar Healing Grenade /> grants 12% Grenade Ability Energy. This gain is unaffected by ability energy gain scalars.

source.text:
Coldsnap Grenades have better tracking, and travel 17.5% further and faster. 

Coldsnap, Storm, Threadling, and Vortex Grenades grant Grenade Energy upon dealing damage.
Healing Grenades grant Fixed Grenade Energy upon healing the user or an ally.
Vortex Grenades have a ~0.8s cooldown between energy gains on a single target.

Coldsnap Grenade Ability Energy:
T1 Combatant = 10% | T2 = 22% | T3 = 34% | T4 = 50% | Guardian = 7%

Storm, Healing, Threadling, and Vortex Grenade Ability Energy:
T1 Combatant = 3% | T2 = 5.7% | T3 = 8.4% | T4 & Healing = 12% | Guardian = 5%
